item.title: Version 26.10.120
item.description:
What's New in 26.10.120

  • Snap Assist & auto-fill for the opposite half when tiling left or right — After you tile a window to the left or right half, AnyDrag can now fill the other half of that screen in two ways under Settings → Middle-click action → Tile by direction → Opposite half when tiling left or right:
    • Snap Assist (Pick window) (default) — Shows a Windows 11–style glass picker in the empty half with the other open windows on that display; click any card or press Return to snap the first candidate into the opposite half, or press Esc / click outside to dismiss. Granting optional Screen Recording permission right from Settings enables live window thumbnails; without it, cards show a clean app icon and window title without ever prompting on their own.
    • Auto-fill with next window — Immediately places the top-most remaining window on that screen into the other half — so tiling the frontmost window B to the left puts the second-most-recent window A on the right, and tiling a background window A to the left puts the frontmost window B on the right.
    • Off — Leaves the other half untouched.
    Both windows remember their original sizes for Restore and pair up for linked resize automatically. Thanks to X user goDavi（狗大V国际版） (@corndogjpn2) for the suggestion (#61).
  • Tiled windows come to the front after you place them — When you use the middle-button tile panel on a background window, holding the middle button leaves the window's layer untouched while you pick a spot; once you release on a tile zone (left, right, corners, center, or full), the tiled window is brought to the front and given focus at its new position. Thanks to X user goDavi（狗大V国际版） (@corndogjpn2) for the suggestion (#62).
  • Proportional cross-display move with whole-point coordinates — Moving a window to another display via the center cell of that display's card now scales both its position and size proportionally to the destination screen's visible area and rounds x, y, width, and height to whole points — preventing windows and cell previews from overflowing when moving from a higher-resolution display (e.g. 2K/4K) to a lower-resolution display (e.g. 1080p). Thanks to 小红书 user 鱼小墨 for reporting this.
  • Option + right-click resize no longer resizes symmetrically — With Option set as your drag modifier, right-dragging to resize a window now strips the Option flag from the mouse stream so macOS apps don't treat it as an Option-resize from the window center. Contributed by @joel-cofactr (#63).

26.10.120 更新内容

  • 左右分屏支持 Windows 11 风格 Snap Assist 选窗与自动补位 — 用中键平铺面板把窗口放到左半屏或右半屏后，现在可以在「设置 → 鼠标中键动作 → 按方向平铺 → 左右分屏时对侧半屏」中选择三种模式：
    • 分屏助手（手动选择窗口）（默认）— 在空出的半边屏幕上弹出毛玻璃选窗面板，列出当前屏幕上的其它打开窗口；点击任意卡片或按 回车（Return）即可将该窗口填入对侧半屏，按 Esc 或点击面板外部即可取消。可在设置页按需开启屏幕录制权限以显示实时窗口缩略图；未开启时默认不会主动弹窗打扰，直接展示简洁的应用图标与窗口标题卡片。
    • 自动填入下一个窗口 — 自动把同一块屏幕上排在最前面的另一个窗口放到对侧半屏——把最前面的窗口 B 拖到左侧，倒数第二活跃的窗口 A 就会自动补到右侧；反过来把后面的窗口 A 拖到左侧，最前面的窗口 B 就会自动补到右侧。
    • 关闭 — 保持对侧半屏原样不动。
    成对的两个窗口都会记录原始尺寸以支持恢复，并自动组成可联动拖拽中间分割线的分屏对。感谢 X 用户 goDavi（狗大V国际版）（@corndogjpn2）提出建议（#61）。
  • 中键平铺落位后自动置顶窗口 — 在后台窗口上按住鼠标中键呼出平铺面板时，窗口保持原有层级不变（取消手势不会打乱窗口顺序）；当你选定具体平铺区域（左侧、右侧、四角、居中或全屏）松手挪过去之后，该窗口会自动激活并提到最前面获得焦点。感谢 X 用户 goDavi（狗大V国际版）（@corndogjpn2）提出建议（#62）。
  • 跨显示器移动改为按比例映射并取整坐标 — 在多显示器平铺面板中，通过其它屏幕卡片的中间格子把窗口移过去时，现在会按目标屏幕可见区域等比例换算窗口的位置与宽高，并将转换后的 x、y、width、height 全部取整为整数点，彻底解决从高分辨率屏幕（如 2K/4K）移往低分辨率屏幕（如 1080P）时预览小块和窗口溢出的问题。感谢小红书用户 鱼小墨 反馈。
  • 修复 Option + 右键缩放触发对称缩放的问题 — 当主修饰键包含 Option 时，右键拖动缩放窗口会自动剥离鼠标事件中的 Option 标记，避免部分原生应用将其识别为按住 Option 从中心对称缩放。感谢 @joel-cofactr 贡献（#63）。

What's New in 26.10.119

  • New option: auto-fill the opposite half when tiling left or right — Turn on Settings → Middle-click action → Tile by direction → Auto-fill opposite half and tiling a window to the left or right half with the middle-button panel automatically places the top-most remaining window on that screen into the other half — so tiling the frontmost window B to the left puts the second-most-recent window A on the right, and tiling a background window A to the left puts the frontmost window B on the right. Both windows remember their original sizes for Restore and pair up for linked resize automatically. Thanks to X user goDavi（狗大V国际版） (@corndogjpn2) for the suggestion (#61).
  • Tiled windows come to the front after you place them — When you use the middle-button tile panel on a background window, holding the middle button leaves the window's layer untouched while you pick a spot; once you release on a tile zone (left, right, corners, center, or full), the tiled window is brought to the front and given focus at its new position. Thanks to X user goDavi（狗大V国际版） (@corndogjpn2) for the suggestion (#62).

26.10.119 更新内容

  • 新选项：左右分屏时自动补位另一侧 — 打开「设置 → 鼠标中键动作 → 按方向平铺 → 左右分屏时自动补位另一侧」后，用中键平铺面板把窗口放到左半屏或右半屏时，会自动把同一块屏幕上排在最前面的另一个窗口放到对侧半屏——把最前面的窗口 B 拖到左侧，倒数第二活跃的窗口 A 就会自动补到右侧；反过来把后面的窗口 A 拖到左侧，最前面的窗口 B 就会自动补到右侧。两个窗口都会记录原始尺寸以支持恢复，并自动组成可联动拖拽中间分割线的分屏对。感谢 X 用户 goDavi（狗大V国际版）（@corndogjpn2）提出建议（#61）。
  • 中键平铺落位后自动置顶窗口 — 在后台窗口上按住鼠标中键呼出平铺面板时，窗口保持原有层级不变（取消手势不会打乱窗口顺序）；当你选定具体平铺区域（左侧、右侧、四角、居中或全屏）松手挪过去之后，该窗口会自动激活并提到最前面获得焦点。感谢 X 用户 goDavi（狗大V国际版）（@corndogjpn2）提出建议（#62）。

What's New in 26.10.118

  • Windows stay sharp after you drag them — After moving a window with AnyDrag, its contents could look slightly blurry until you dragged it once more by its real title bar. The mouse reports positions in fractions of a point, and AnyDrag passed those fractions on, so a window could come to rest between two pixels. AnyDrag now rounds every position in a drag to whole points, so the window always lands exactly on the pixel grid. It was easiest to notice on external displays at 1× scaling. Contributed by @jnchman (#58).
  • New option: always resize from the bottom-right corner — Turn on Settings → Window Resize → Always resize from bottom-right and a resize gesture always moves the bottom-right corner while the top-left corner stays put, no matter where in the window you start dragging. It's off by default, so resizing from the nearest corner works exactly as before. Contributed by @jnchman (#58).

26.10.118 更新内容

  • 拖完窗口不再发虚 — 用 AnyDrag 移动窗口后，窗口里的内容有时会微微发虚，要用真正的标题栏再拖一次才会恢复清晰。原因是鼠标报告的位置带小数，AnyDrag 原样传了过去，窗口就可能停在两个像素之间。现在拖动过程中的每个位置都会四舍五入到整数点，窗口一定落在像素网格上。外接显示器用 1 倍缩放时最明显。感谢 @jnchman 贡献（#58）。
  • 新选项：始终从右下角缩放 — 打开「设置 → 窗口缩放 → 始终从右下角缩放」后，不管从窗口哪个位置开始拖，缩放时都是右下角跟着鼠标走，左上角保持不动。这个选项默认关闭，不打开的话还是和以前一样，从离鼠标最近的角缩放。感谢 @jnchman 贡献（#58）。

What's New in 26.10.117

  • Show the app icon in the menu bar, the Dock, or both — New in Settings → General → Show App Icon In: Menu Bar (the default, exactly as before), Dock, or Menu Bar and Dock. With the Dock icon on, clicking it — or opening AnyDrag a second time — brings up the Settings window, so hiding the menu bar icon can never lock you out of the app. Switching takes effect immediately, no relaunch needed. Thanks to @hexeric for the request (#52).
  • A plain ⌘-click reaches the app again — With Command as the only drag modifier, a ⌘-click that never turned into a drag was swallowed, so ⌘-clicking a link in a browser didn't open it in a new tab. Such a click is now passed through to the app untouched; ⌘-drag moves windows exactly as before. Thanks to @Plazman888 for reporting it (#53).

26.10.117 更新内容

  • App 图标可以放在菜单栏、Dock，或者两边都放 — 「设置 → 通用 → App 图标显示在」新增三选一：「菜单栏」（默认，和以前完全一样）、「Dock」、「菜单栏和 Dock」。开着 Dock 图标时，点一下它，或者再启动一次 AnyDrag，就能叫出设置窗口，所以把菜单栏图标藏起来也不会再找不到入口。切换立即生效，不用重启。感谢 @hexeric 提出这个需求（#52）。
  • 普通的 ⌘ 点击又能传给 app 了 — 只用 Command 作为拖动修饰键时，按下 ⌘ 点一下、没有拖动的那次点击会被吞掉，于是在浏览器里 ⌘ 点链接不再会新开标签页。现在这种点击会原样放行给 app；⌘ 拖动窗口和以前完全一样。感谢 @Plazman888 反馈（#53）。

What's New in 26.10.116

  • Close, minimize, or full-screen a window from the tile panel — The middle-button tile panel now has a strip under the grid of the display you're on: a small close button on the left, minimize across the middle, and a small full-screen button on the right. Hold the middle button, move onto one, and release. Close presses the window's own close button, so an app with unsaved changes still asks before closing; full screen works like the window's green button, and doing it again on a full-screen window exits full screen. To hide the strip, turn off Settings → Middle-click action → Tile by direction → Show close, minimize, and full-screen buttons.

26.10.116 更新内容

  • 在平铺面板里直接关闭、最小化、全屏窗口 — 鼠标中键的平铺面板里，当前显示器那张卡片的格子下方多了一条：左边是一个小的关闭按钮，中间一长条是最小化，右边是一个小的全屏按钮。按住鼠标中键移到上面，松开即可。关闭等于按下窗口自己的关闭按钮，有未保存内容的 app 照常会先问你；全屏和窗口的绿色按钮一样，对已经全屏的窗口再做一次就退出全屏。不想要这一条，可以在「设置 → 鼠标中键动作 → 按方向平铺 → 显示关闭、最小化、全屏按钮」里关掉。

What's New in 26.09.115

  • Dragging windows works again on macOS 27 — AnyDrag moves a window by planting a synthesized click just inside its title bar, 3 pt below the window's top edge. macOS 27 no longer accepts a click that high as a title-bar drag, so windows simply stopped moving — with no error, and only in some apps, while resizing kept working throughout. The default is now 4 pt on macOS 27 and later, and stays 3 pt on macOS 26 and earlier. If you had already changed Settings → General → Diagnostics → Title-bar Y offset by hand, your own value is kept — press Reset on that row to take the new default. Thanks to @alejandrovegab (#49) and @hexeric (#51) for reporting it and for pinning down which apps were affected.

26.09.115 更新内容

  • macOS 27 上窗口又能拖动了 — AnyDrag 移动窗口的办法,是在窗口顶边下方 3 pt 处、也就是标题栏里侧,放一个模拟点击。macOS 27 已经不再把这么靠上的点击当作标题栏拖动,于是窗口就是不动——没有任何报错,而且只有一部分 app 受影响,缩放窗口却始终是好的。现在 macOS 27 及以后默认改为 4 pt,macOS 26 及以前仍是 3 pt。如果你自己手动改过「设置 → 通用 → 诊断 → 标题栏 Y 偏移」,你填的值会保留;想用上新的默认值,按那一行的「重置」。感谢 @alejandrovegab(#49)和 @hexeric(#51)反馈,并帮忙确认了受影响的 app 范围。

What's New in 26.09.114

  • Drag windows that have no title bar — Some windows are much larger than they look. Codex's floating Ask ChatGPT anything bar keeps roughly 180 pt of transparent space above itself for the results panel, so AnyDrag aimed at the top edge of the window, grabbed empty space, and nothing moved. AnyDrag now measures where such a window's visible part starts and grabs that instead — and no longer pulls the app's main window out from behind whatever you had in front when you move one. Windows with an ordinary title bar behave exactly as before. Thanks to @Depixelate for reporting it (#43).
  • The left-drag resize key can be part of your move shortcut — Set the primary modifier to Control + Command and Settings → Window Resize → Left-drag → Left-drag Resize Modifier to Control on its own: Control + drag resizes a window, Control + Command + drag moves it. Only making the two shortcuts identical is still refused. Contributed by @zuozh11 (#47).

26.09.114 更新内容

  • 没有标题栏的窗口也能拖了 — 有些窗口比看上去大一圈:Codex 那个悬浮的 Ask ChatGPT anything 输入条,上方留了大约 180 点的透明区域给结果面板展开。AnyDrag 原本对准窗口的顶边,就抓在了这片空白上,窗口纹丝不动。现在会先量出这类窗口看得见的部分从哪儿开始、抓那儿;拖动它们时也不再把该应用的主窗口从你原本的窗口后面拽到前台。有正常标题栏的窗口行为完全不变。感谢 @Depixelate 反馈(#43)。
  • 左键缩放的修饰键可以是移动快捷键的一部分 — 把主修饰键设成 Control + Command,再把「设置 → 窗口缩放 → 左键拖动 → 左键缩放修饰键」单独设成 Control:按住 Control 拖动是缩放窗口,按住 Control + Command 拖动是移动窗口。只有两者完全相同时才仍然禁止。感谢 @zuozh11 贡献(#47)。

What's New in 26.07.113

  • Send a window to another display, untouched — In the multi-display tile panel (hold the middle button and drag), stopping on the center cell of another display's card now sends the window to that display exactly as it is — same size, same relative position, not tiled. The small rectangle drawn inside that cell previews where it will land. The center cell of the card you started on is still cancel.
  • Compatible with BetterMouse — With BetterMouse running, holding Control and dragging a window only popped a context menu; the window never moved. BetterMouse re-applies modifier flags to left-button events from the physical key state, which undid the Control flag AnyDrag has to clear for its title-bar drag — so macOS read every drag as a right-click. AnyDrag now repeats that clear at the very end of the event chain, and creates it at the start of each gesture, so it holds no matter which app launched first or was restarted. Thanks to @Leroy-X for reporting it and narrowing it down to BetterMouse in a clean VM (#27). The full investigation is written up here.
  • Steadier target label — In the multi-display tile panel, the label naming your target now stays anchored over the current display's card.

26.07.113 更新内容

  • 把窗口原封不动地送到另一块屏幕 — 多显示器的平铺面板里(按住中键拖动),停在别的屏幕那张卡片的中间格子上,窗口会原封不动地搬到那块屏幕——大小不变、相对位置不变,而不是被平铺。格子里画的小方块就是它落点的预览。手势起始的那张卡片,中间格子仍然是取消。
  • 兼容 BetterMouse — 开着 BetterMouse 时,按住 Control 拖窗口只会弹出右键菜单,窗口纹丝不动。BetterMouse 会按物理按键的当前状态,把修饰键标记重新盖到左键事件上,于是 AnyDrag 为了实现标题栏拖动而必须抹掉的 Control 标记又被贴了回去——macOS 就把每次拖动都当成了右键。AnyDrag 现在会在事件链的最末端把它再抹一次,并且在每次手势开始时才创建,所以无论两个 App 谁先启动、谁重启过,都能生效。感谢 @Leroy-X 反馈,并在干净的虚拟机里把范围缩小到 BetterMouse(#27)。完整的排查过程写在这里。
  • 目标标签不再飘 — 多显示器平铺面板里,标注目标的那个标签现在固定显示在当前显示器那张卡片上。

What's New in 26.07.112

  • Center, Restore original size and Minimize in the tiling panel — The panel you get by holding your modifier and right-clicking a window has a third row under Move & Resize: Center, Restore original size and Minimize. Restore puts a window back the way it was before AnyDrag first moved it, and stays greyed out — "Nothing to restore — AnyDrag hasn't moved this window yet" — for windows AnyDrag never touched. The centered size is now yours to choose in Settings → Window Drag → Advanced Tweaks → Centered window size (50%–85%, default 85%), the same value the middle-button drag-down center uses. Thanks to 小红书 user 配音员泽坤 for the suggestion (#30).
  • A cleaner panel for tile-by-direction — The panel that appears while you hold the middle button and drag has no borders left at all: every connected display is now its own piece of frosted glass with its name in the top-left corner, and the display you're on is marked with a small coloured dot instead of a blue frame. A faint tint in your system accent colour keeps the glass from disappearing into the window behind it.

26.07.112 更新内容

  • 平铺面板新增「居中 / 恢复原始大小 / 最小化」 — 按住主修饰键、右键点窗口弹出的平铺面板,「移动与调整大小」下多了第三行:居中、恢复原始大小、最小化。「恢复原始大小」把窗口放回 AnyDrag 第一次动它之前的样子;AnyDrag 没动过的窗口,这个按钮是灰的,提示「没有可恢复的尺寸 —— AnyDrag 还没动过这个窗口」。居中的大小现在可以自己定:设置 → 窗口拖动 → 高级 tweak → 居中窗口大小(50%–85%,默认 85%),和按住中键下滑的居中用的是同一个值。感谢小红书用户 配音员泽坤 提出建议(#30)。
  • 按方向平铺的面板换了个样子 — 按住鼠标中键拖动时弹出的那个面板,现在一根边框都没有了:每台显示器是一块独立的毛玻璃,名字写在左上角,你当前所在的那台用一个小彩点标记,不再用蓝色边框圈起来。玻璃上加了一层很淡的系统强调色,盖在别的窗口上时不会和背景糊成一片。

What's New in 26.07.111

  • Tile menu closes when you release the modifier — When you hold your modifier and right-click a window to open the tile menu, letting go of that modifier now closes it right away instead of leaving it on screen. Choosing a tile, clicking elsewhere, or pressing Esc still close it too. Thanks to 小红书 user 配音员泽坤 for reporting this (#29).

26.07.111 更新内容

  • 松开修饰键即关闭平铺菜单 — 按住主修饰键、右键点窗口弹出平铺菜单后,现在一松开该修饰键,菜单就立即关闭,不再留在屏幕上。选择某个平铺格子、点击别处、或按 Esc 也同样可以关闭。感谢小红书用户 配音员泽坤 反馈(#29)。

What's New in 26.07.110

  • Linked resize for tiled pairs — Tile two windows into a complementary pair (left + right, or top + bottom), then move the pointer to their shared seam and drag with the plain left button to resize both at once. Toggle it under Settings → Middle-click action → Linked resize. Contributed by @eunrui (#26).
  • Tile panel stays fully on screen — Near a screen edge, the middle-click tile panel now keeps itself fully visible and glides the cursor to its center. Prefer it right at the cursor instead? Turn off Settings → Middle-click action → Keep tile panel on screen. Contributed by @eunrui (#22).
  • No more frozen clicks after revoking Accessibility — Turning off AnyDrag's Accessibility permission while it's running no longer risks freezing mouse clicks system-wide — AnyDrag now fails safe, recovers on its own, and re-prompts for permission. Contributed by @eunrui (#24).
  • Cleaner tile overlay — Fixed the white corners that could show around the middle-click tile overlay. Contributed by @eunrui (#23).

26.07.110 更新内容

  • 平铺窗口对的联动缩放 — 把两个窗口平铺成互补的一对(左半 + 右半,或上半 + 下半),再把光标移到它们中间的公共边,用普通左键拖动即可同时缩放两个窗口。可在「设置 → 鼠标中键动作 → 联动缩放」里开关。感谢 @eunrui 贡献(#26)。
  • 平铺面板始终完整显示 — 靠近屏幕边缘时,中键平铺面板现在会保持完整可见,并把光标滑到面板中心。想让它就在光标处出现?可关闭「设置 → 鼠标中键动作 → 让平铺面板始终完整显示」。感谢 @eunrui 贡献(#22)。
  • 撤销辅助功能权限后不再冻结点击 — 在 AnyDrag 运行时关闭它的辅助功能权限,不再有冻结全系统鼠标点击的风险——AnyDrag 现在会安全失效、自动恢复,并再次弹出权限申请。感谢 @eunrui 贡献(#24)。
  • 平铺浮层更干净 — 修复中键平铺浮层四角可能出现的白边。感谢 @eunrui 贡献(#23)。

26.05.101 更新内容

What's New in 26.05.100

  • The middle-button tile gesture got a real preview panel — Until now, holding the middle button just showed a small cancel ring; you had to memorize that drag-up meant Full Screen, drag-down-right meant Bottom-Right Quarter, and so on. AnyDrag now pops up a tiny screen-shaped panel laid out as a 3×3 grid — each cell shows a mini preview of where the window will land, and the cell under your cursor lights up. The center cell is the cancel zone — release there to abort.
  • Frosted-glass overlay — The new tile panel uses macOS vibrancy (.hudWindow), so the desktop and the underlying window blur softly through it — same material family as Control Center and the volume HUD.
  • No more stray middle-click after cancelling a tile — Previously, if you dragged out to pick a direction and then dragged back into the cancel area, the underlying app still received a middle-click on release (which could accidentally close a browser tab). Now: a gesture that actively chose a direction and then changed its mind cancels cleanly — no middle-click forwarded. A pure quick tap of the middle button (cursor never left the center) still forwards as before, so middle-click-to-open-tab continues to work.
  • First release on the new CalVer version scheme — Version numbers move to YY.MM.<build> (this is build 100). Sparkle compares build numbers, so updates from 1.4.2 still flow correctly.

What's New in 1.4.2

  • Fix: memory grew on every window drag and never came back down — AnyDrag's event tap was over-retaining each mouse event it processed, leaking one system event object per event. During a drag (dozens to hundreds of events per second) memory climbed steadily and never recovered — one report reached 500 MB. The events are now released correctly per the event-tap contract. (Thanks to @eunrui for the clear report in #9.)
  • Fix: memory spike during middle-button tile preview — While sliding to preview a tile target, the translucent preview overlay allocated a full-resolution bitmap the size of the previewed region — tens of MB per preview on high-resolution displays. The overlay is now GPU-composited, so it costs almost nothing regardless of the previewed area.

1.4.2 更新内容

  • 修复:每次拖动窗口内存都会增加且不回落 — AnyDrag 的事件 tap 在处理每个鼠标事件时多持有了一次引用,导致每经过一个系统事件就泄漏一个事件对象。拖动时鼠标事件每秒高达几十上百个,内存因此持续上涨且降不下来——有用户反馈涨到了 500 MB。现在事件会按照事件 tap 的约定被正确释放。(感谢 @eunrui 在 #9 提交清晰的反馈)
  • 修复:鼠标中键平铺预览时内存骤增 — 滑动预览平铺落点时,那个半透明预览框会按预览区域大小分配一整块全分辨率位图,在高分屏上每次预览要占用几十 MB。现在预览框改由 GPU 合成,无论预览区域多大占用都极小。

What's New in 1.4.1

  • Refreshed app icon — The icon artwork now uses the correct safe-area padding inside the macOS rounded-square mask, so it sits properly aligned in the Dock, Finder, and Launchpad instead of running edge-to-edge. No functional changes.

1.4.1 更新内容

  • 更新应用图标 — 图标素材现在按 macOS 圆角方形遮罩的安全区留出了正确的内边距,在程序坞、访达和启动台中显示更规范,不再顶到边缘。无功能性改动。

What's New in 1.4.0

  • Fix: Accessibility permission row stuck on "Granted" after revoke — In Settings → General, the Accessibility row continued to display "🟢 Granted" indefinitely after the permission was toggled off in System Settings. AnyDrag now correctly reflects the current permission state shortly after each toggle. (Thanks to @FisherRone for the careful reproduction and reporting in #7.)
  • Fix: revoking Accessibility could freeze every mouse click system-wide — The protection shipped in 1.3.0 regressed in 1.3.2: after a revoke, AnyDrag's recovery path was inadvertently resurrecting the unauthorized event tap instead of tearing it down, leaving it at the head of the system event chain swallowing every click. AnyDrag now detects the revoke reliably and removes the tap cleanly.
  • Fix: launch permission alert could be silently skipped — On macOS 14/15, AnyDrag's internal trust probe (a listen-only mouse event tap) would succeed even when Accessibility was actually denied, so the launch flow concluded "permissions OK" and never showed the request alert — the app appeared running but the event tap never started. The launch flow now uses the documented AXIsProcessTrusted() API as the single source of truth, so the alert appears when needed.

1.4.0 更新内容

  • 修复:撤销辅助功能权限后,设置页里依然显示「已授权」 — 在「设置 → 通用」中,即便已在系统设置里关掉 AnyDrag 的辅助功能权限,「辅助功能」一行还是会长时间显示「🟢 已授权」。现在切换权限后界面会快速同步到正确状态。(感谢 @FisherRone 在 #7 仔细复现并提交反馈)
  • 修复:撤销辅助功能权限可能导致全系统鼠标点击被吞掉 — 1.3.0 修过的这个问题在 1.3.2 中悄悄回归:撤销权限后,引擎的恢复路径会反过来「复活」已经失去授权的事件 tap,把它留在系统事件链顶端吞掉所有点击事件。现在 AnyDrag 能可靠识别权限撤销并干净拆除 tap。
  • 修复:权限未授予时,启动权限请求弹窗可能被静默跳过 — 在 macOS 14/15 上,AnyDrag 之前用来探测权限的内部探针(一个 listen-only 鼠标事件 tap)在没有权限时也会创建成功,导致启动流程错误地认为「权限 OK」,既不弹请求也不报错——看起来 app 已经在运行,实际 event tap 根本没起来。启动流程现在改用文档化的 AXIsProcessTrusted() API 作为唯一权限事实,该弹的时候就会弹。

What's New in 1.3.3

  • Improved diagnostics for "no reaction" reports — When a click with the configured modifier doesn't engage AnyDrag, the log now records the observed vs. expected modifier so reports can be triaged in one round-trip. The app name of the window under the cursor is also captured at engagement points (drag start, maximize toggle, tile commit), so reports like "AnyDrag doesn't work in app X" can be matched to log evidence at a glance. Logs live at ~/Library/Logs/AnyDrag/AnyDrag.log.

1.3.3 更新内容

  • 诊断日志增强,方便定位「按了没反应」类问题 — 当带修饰键的点击没能触发 AnyDrag 时,日志现在会记录实际按下的修饰键和配置的修饰键,反馈问题时不需要再来回追问。同时在拖动、最大化、平铺等触发点会记录目标 App 的名字,「在某某 App 里不工作」的反馈可以直接对照日志定位。日志位置:~/Library/Logs/AnyDrag/AnyDrag.log。

What's New in 1.3.2

  • Fix: spurious Input Monitoring permission prompt — A trust probe added in 1.3.0 was listening for keyboard events with a throwaway tap, which made macOS prompt users for Input Monitoring even though AnyDrag never reads keyboard input. The probe now uses a mouse event, so only Accessibility is requested.
  • Fix: drag broken on a secondary display positioned above the primary — A long-standing menu-bar-skip check was treating every click with negative CG Y as a menu-bar click, which silently swallowed all clicks on a display arranged above the primary. AnyDrag now works correctly regardless of the display's position relative to the primary. (Thanks to @cpan-NS1 for reporting in #4.)
  • In-app language picker — Switch the AnyDrag UI between Follow System, English, and 简体中文 from Settings → General. Takes effect immediately, no relaunch.
  • Settings reorganized into three tabs — General (language, accessibility permission, launch at login, diagnostics), Advanced (modifier keys, feature toggles, middle-click action), and About. Window width stays stable while you switch tabs.
  • Accessibility permission visible in Settings — General tab shows a green dot when authorized, or a one-click Authorize button that opens System Settings when not. The status updates live as you toggle the permission.
  • Revoking AX permission no longer freezes the system — In earlier versions, toggling off AnyDrag's Accessibility permission in System Settings would lock the entire macOS input pipeline (no mouse, no keyboard, hard reboot required). AnyDrag now detects the revocation and tears the event tap down cleanly. When permission is granted again it restarts on its own.
  • More Apps by Author — New menu-bar item linking to xueshi.dev for quick access to other apps.
  • Middle-button tile drag is cancellable — During a middle-button tile-by-direction gesture, drag back into the small dot at the press origin to cancel — even after passing the trigger threshold.
  • Diagnostics always visible — The "title-bar Y offset" knob (useful for apps like WeChat with non-standard top bars) and the synthesized-click marker now live under Settings → General → Diagnostics by default. Values persist across launches, with a Reset button to restore the default 3 px.
  • Bug fixes and stability improvements

1.3.2 更新内容

  • 修复:错误提示需要"输入监控"权限 — 1.3.0 引入的权限探测在创建临时 tap 时把 keyDown 加进了事件 mask,导致 macOS 误以为 AnyDrag 想读键盘,从而弹出"输入监控"权限请求。AnyDrag 实际上从不读键盘——已改成探测鼠标事件,现在只会请求"辅助功能"。
  • 修复:副屏摆放在主屏正上方时,副屏上无法触发拖动 — 历史遗留的菜单栏跳过逻辑只判 Y < 25,而 CG 全屏坐标里副屏位于主屏上方时 Y 为负数,会被误判为"主屏菜单栏点击"而透传,导致 AnyDrag 在该副屏上完全无响应。现在不论副屏摆放方位都能正常工作。(感谢 @cpan-NS1 在 #4 提交反馈)
  • 应用内语言切换 — 在「设置 → 通用」中可在「跟随系统 / English / 简体中文」之间切换 AnyDrag 界面语言,切换立即生效,无需重启。
  • 设置页重新组织为三个标签页 — 通用(语言、辅助功能权限、登录时启动、诊断)、高级(修饰键、功能开关、鼠标中键动作)、关于。切换标签时窗体宽度不再变化。
  • 设置页中可直接看到辅助功能权限状态 — 通用页显示绿点 + 「已授权」,未授权时显示「授权」按钮一键跳转系统设置;权限变化实时刷新。
  • 撤销辅助功能权限不再导致系统冻结 — 之前在系统设置里关闭 AnyDrag 的辅助功能权限会让整个 macOS 输入管道死锁,鼠标键盘全部失灵,只能强制重启。现在 AnyDrag 会立刻检测到权限撤销并干净地拆除事件 tap;重新授权时会自动恢复。
  • 菜单栏新增「作者的更多应用」入口 — 跳转至 xueshi.dev,方便查看作者的其他应用。
  • 中键平铺手势可取消 — 按住中键进行方向平铺时,即使已经越过触发阈值,把光标拖回起点附近的小圆点上即可取消本次平铺。
  • 诊断设置默认可见 — 「标题栏 Y 偏移」(对微信等顶栏非标准的应用有用)和「模拟点击标记」现在默认显示在「设置 → 通用 → 诊断」中,设置会持久保存,并新增「重置」按钮可还原为默认的 3 px。
  • Bug 修复与稳定性改进
